def sanitize_directory(directory)
  # Remove any leading or trailing slashes and ensure no directory traversal
  directory.gsub(/\A\.\.\/|\/\.\.\z/, '').gsub(/\/+/, '/')
end

# Test cases to verify directory sanitization
puts sanitize_directory("../etc/passwd") # Expected: "etc/passwd"
puts sanitize_directory("/var/www/../")  # Expected: "var/www"
puts sanitize_directory("folder//subfolder") # Expected: "folder/subfolder"
